user.title: Bus company
user.description:
Choose the company that operates your route.

- **KMB / LWB**: Kowloon Motor Bus and Long Win Bus routes (e.g. 1A, 270, A31)
- **Citybus / NWFB**: Citybus routes, including former NWFB routes (e.g. 5B, 788)

route.title: Bus route
route.description: Enter the route number, for example **1A**, **788** or **A31**.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Pick the direction of travel (origin → destination).

stop.title: Bus stop
stop.description: Pick a stop served by this route and direction from the list, or type a bus stop ID directly (searching in the dropdown also filters by stop name).

time_format.title: Display format
time_format.description: Choose how the arrival times should be displayed. This can be changed later in the integration options.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the bus data service. Please try again.
error.route_not_found: This route was not found for the selected company.

abort.already_configured: This route, direction and stop combination is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the bus data service. Please try again later.
abort.no_directions: No directions found for this route.

init.title: HK Bus Time Table options
init.description: Changing the display format recreates the sensors.

data_description.scan_interval: How often arrival times are refreshed. Please be a good API citizen - 30 seconds is plenty for bus display boards.
